frontmatter.name: seed-data
frontmatter.description: Onboard a fresh clone of ai-sdlc-course and get the local SQLite dev database seeded and ready. Use whenever the user asks to "seed data", "reset the database", "start development" / "onboard" on this project, sees empty product/category/brand lists in the app or in tests, or gets SQLite errors like "no such table". Explains that seeding is automatic (no npm script), how to force a clean re-seed, and how to add new seed data safely.
